capabilities: Link a plugin folder into the vault as a symlink from settings
Reload a linked plugin when its build output files change
Install plugin builds from GitHub pull requests or branches
Override store-installed or BRAT-installed plugins and restore them after unlinking
Sign in to GitHub and download workflow artifacts, including from private repositories
disambiguation: Not a note-linking tool; it manages symlinks to plugin folders and GitHub Actions builds for plugin development and testing.
extras: Folder links work only on desktop; GitHub builds work on desktop and mobile. Uses Obsidian's internal plugin API to enable, disable and reload plugins, which may change in future versions. Pre-release versions are available via BRAT (zachhannum/obsidian-local-plugin-linker). README includes a security disclosures section about file system and network access.
problem: Developing an Obsidian plugin requires placing files in the vault's plugins folder, and testing pull-request builds, especially on mobile, is not supported.

relations.evidence: You can link a folder or install a build over a plugin that you installed from the store or from BRAT.

summary: Developer tool that links plugin folders into a vault via symlink and installs plugin builds from GitHub pull requests and branches, reloading plugins on rebuild.
